newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes down on speculation.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes down on speculation.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso contract closed down three centavos to 7.4935/7.4980 per dollar as local banks speculated before the end of the month, dealers said.
"I think that the market is not as short as people say, and the demand feels more speculative than real," said one analyst.
The 24-hour peso contract was down 1.1 centavos to 7.4970/7.5020 per dollar, while the spot 48-hour fell 1.05 centavos to 7.5025/7.5060 per dollar in midday trade.
The peso also lost strength as the return on the U.S. 30-year Treasury bond rose.
"We are affected by movements in the long-bond, although less than expected as foreign investors have not been seen in the market," said one dealer.
